issues.legal_issue: Compensation for land acquired for an expressway must be reassessed where the valuation relies on a later acquisition, an unjustified belting system, or unsupported cuts.
material_facts: Land was acquired for an expressway project, and both the landowners and the State challenged the compensation awarded.
The High Court relied on a later acquisition and made an adjustment to determine the value of the acquired land.
The High Court adopted a belting system and introduced cuts in valuing land along the expressway.
The Supreme Court considered the value prevailing in the locality before the acquisition notification to be a main relevant factor.

The Supreme Court directed the High Court to consider available valuation documents, the increase in adjoining land values that a new road may bring, and restrictions on land use extending 200 feet on either side of the road.
issues.conclusion: The Supreme Court set aside the High Court's order and remitted the matters for fresh consideration. On reassessment, the High Court was to consider the locality's pre-notification land value, the road's effect on adjoining land values, and the restrictions on land use alongside the road.
issues.legal_principle: For compensation assessment under the Land Acquisition Act, the value prevailing in the locality before the Section 4(1) notification is a main relevant factor. In this expressway acquisition, reliance on a later acquisition with an appropriate reduction was erroneous; a belting system was unjustified for an expressway passing through different parcels of land; and the High Court erred in introducing cuts. The reassessing court should also consider the development and increase in value that a road may bring to adjoining land, as well as restrictions on land use extending 200 feet on either side. No earlier cases are cited.

rule.if: compensation_appeal and (later_acquisition_used or belting_used or cuts_applied)

predicates.compensation_appeal: The matter is an appeal challenging compensation determined for land acquired for a road project.
predicates.later_acquisition_used: The court determining compensation relied on a later acquisition and adjusted its value to assess the acquired land.
predicates.belting_used: The court determining compensation divided the acquired land into belts to assign different values.
predicates.cuts_applied: The court determining compensation reduced the assessed land value by applying cuts.
predicates.compensation_valuation_set_aside_and_rem: The compensation determination is set aside and the matter is sent back for fresh consideration.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges road-project land compensation and the valuation used a later acquisition, belting, or cuts, the compensation determination is set aside and the matter is sent back for fresh consideration.
